notes:
I couldn't write the notes. My research tool reached its limit for this turn before I could read any of the pages.

I asked for six sources at once: Enduring Word, Precept Austin, Ellicott, Gill and the Pulpit Commentary (all three on Bible Hub), and the NET Bible notes for Jeremiah 6. A bug in my own code meant I never displayed what came back, and the tool then stopped me from making any more requests. I didn't see a single line from any of them.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say, and I haven't read any. So I've written no verse notes, and I won't fill the gaps from memory.

If you ask again, I'll start with those six sources, then move on to:
- **Places where Protestant traditions differ:** Wesley's Notes, Spurgeon's sermons on Jeremiah 6:14 ("Peace, peace") and 6:16 ("the ancient paths"), Ligonier, Desiring God, Grace to You, LCMS and 1517.
- **Other views:** Catholic and Orthodox readings from New Advent, Catholic.com and OCA, plus Bible Odyssey for modern scholarship.

I'll then write the verse-by-verse notes, with the page address after each point and anything I couldn't find left out.
